statement: The first sentence states the vote: the fields, required or optional, contested as status or derived, correction as type or rule, or nothing yet with the reason
A section states the case against the chosen shape with at least one concrete scenario in which it fails or misleads
The controls that would show the shape failing are named, each with whether it is reachable through append, inbox, or the report
A section states what retiring the chosen shape would cost
A section names at least one disagreement the shape covers beyond today's instance and at least one it does not
